primary_metric: Common clipped natural-log BCE as v0.6, native BCE separately reported
independent_unit: Within each population, average the two paired seed differences; analyze eight population means per task.
primary_interval: Paired population-mean t interval, df7; display all8 differences. Small-sample distributional assumptions and nominal coverage stated.
interpretation: Negative favors first method; upper bound<0 supports direction under assumptions, upper bound<-0.01 exceeds declared practical reference. Crossingzero is inconclusive, not equivalence.
secondary: native BCE and clipping/extreme logit diagnostics
90/95/97 validation milestones with nonreacher censoring and reached-only medians;97not an annulus expectation
conditional_record_sensitivity: Omitted from this study; registered primary population-mean t inference and descriptive per-record diagnostics only.
no_pooling: Keep v0.7 historical evidence separate. Do not pool independent populations between studies.
checkpoint_scope: Compare validation-selected predictors after equal FULL training budgets; selected steps may differ. Never select on test curves.
interaction_caveat: A negative interaction alone does not establish absolute benefit for either priority arm.

mechanism_diagnostics.training_only_bins: For each fixed geometric router compute margin=d_second_squared-d_nearest_squared on train coordinates. Record train quantile edges[0,.1,.25,.5,1] using explicit linear interpolation; collapse duplicate edges deterministically. Apply unchanged edges to validation/test. All arms scored on the SAME geometric-margin slices.
mechanism_diagnostics.reporting: Per-bank and fixed-margin-bin BCE/F1, record counts, observed positive prevalence, class composition and uncertainty are descriptive; report empty bins and every bin. Do not select bin boundaries, models, epochs or narrative by test advantage.
mechanism_diagnostics.hash_interpretation: Also report hash-bank occupancy, per-bank record visits and minibatch appearances; bank indices across policies are not matched semantic groups.
mechanism_diagnostics.additional: Report learned head weights, coefficient norms, route time, bank gradient/update exposure and packed-Adam movement of absent banks. Distinguish mechanism descriptions from primary causal contrasts.
mechanism_diagnostics.priority: Every round log probabilities, ESS1/sum(p^2), unique records, repetition, bank and class exposure, high-loss draws, refresh/sampler CPU and wall costs. Hidden annulus flips can be used only by post-release diagnostics.
mechanism_diagnostics.milestones: Train/validation every round; fixed curves25/50/100/200; validation macro-F1 first reach90/95/97%, censor all nonreachers. No test checkpoints along curve.

release_gate: All640B commits plus author and independent full endpoint audits, then root hash-bound test release.
independent_replay: Separate implementation of predictions, native logits, all metrics and20 population-mean contrasts.
